body:
This term "tinea unguium" refers to a fungal infection of the nails. However, the exact synonyms include infections of various other body parts. These seem to have been added by mistake.

For example:
cellulitis and abscess of buttock
cellulitis and abscess of face
cellulitis and abscess of gluteal region
cellulitis and abscess of trunk
cellulitis and abscess of upper arm and forearm
